## Checklist-accuracy findings / fixture gaps (for the wave anchor card)

- `search.console-global-search` acceptance[0] says opening when already open is a no-op "not a toggle-closed" beside ⌘K/Ctrl+K; by source design (objectui CommandPaletteProvider) the keyboard accelerator toggles and only buttons, links, deep-links and programmatic callers are idempotent — scope the idempotence to the non-keyboard affordances or a runner will score the toggle as a FAIL.
- `search.console-global-search` step 3 / acceptance[2] suggest the palette query `张`: one character is below the palette's minLength 2, never reaches the wire and shows "No results found." — use `张伟`.
- Area recipe `search:qa-contributor-bound-member`: step 5 should name the invoice-number field `name` (`number` → 400 INVALID_FIELD) and give a seeded account id example; the "system context" of steps 2–3 works as an admin REST read of `sys_user` plus admin `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position {user_id, position: "contributor", organization_id}` (`sys_position` is not a registered object; position is plain text).
- `search.pinyin-flag-both-sides`: the roster now reads 52 loaded (flag off) vs 53 (on) at 5b14b7f3 (was 51/52); the one-plugin difference is what the clause scores. Neither boot prints a literal `requires` list — the banner roster is the readable form. The lookup-picker part of step 5 was not exercised.
